title: Relative right-pinched mapping spaces are Kan fibrations
statement:
Use quasicategories and right-pinched mapping spaces from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. A Kan fibration is a simplicial map lifting every horn of positive dimension, including the outer horns. If $p:E\to B$ is an inner fibration between quasicategories and $x,y\in E$ are vertices, then the induced map
$$\operatorname{Map}_E(x,y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_B(p(x),p(y))$$
is a Kan fibration.
